description: Fluphenazine decanoate is the long-acting injectable ester form of the high-potency typical antipsychotic fluphenazine. It is administered intramuscularly every 2–4 weeks for maintenance therapy in patients with schizophrenia or chronic psychotic disorders. This depot formulation improves adherence and ensures sustained therapeutic drug levels.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Fluphenazine decanoate is the long-acting injectable ester form of the high-potency typical antipsychotic fluphenazine. It is administered intramuscularly every 2–4 weeks for maintenance therapy in patients with schizophrenia or chronic psychotic disorders. This depot formulation improves adherence and ensures sustained therapeutic drug levels.
